subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises onset and rime in more complex patterns (dr-eam, cr-eam, scr-eam, str-eam)

show.line: Dream, cream, scream, stream. Keep the end the same. Change the start. A whole family of words!

rounds.prompt: Dream, cream, stream. Which picture belongs to this family?
Cream. Take off the start and put on s-t-r. What word is it?
Train, brain. Change the start to d-r. What word is it?
Which word does not belong with dream and cream?
rounds.praise: Yes! Drip has a different ending.

rounds.prompt: Ends like dream, or ends like train? Put each word in its group.

hints: Cover the start of the word. Does the rest sound like dream?
Say the new start, then the old ending. Push them together.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Dream. I will change the start to s-c-r.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: s-c-r, then the end of dream. Scram!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Keep the ending the same. Scream, like dream.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. s-c-r, then the end of dream. Scream!

parent_line: Can make new words by changing the start and keeping the ending, like dream, cream and stream.
